Worth a visit
Mar 2025 • Couples
Lovely little place in Hanoi - a place with a sophisticated European feel in the hustle & bustle of Hanoi Old Town. We visited a couple of times, once on a Wednesday which is Jazz night - beautiful soft jazz, not too loud, gave the place a lovely atmosphere. Would recommend if in Hanoi Old town - good wines, & though not extensive, the menu has a good selection - can certainly recommend the cheese board. Hope it continues to thrive!

Proper wine bar
Nov 2024 • Couples
This is a proper wine bar in Hanoi. A range of red and white wines by the glass and an extensive wine by the bottle list. 
Happy hour 4pm to 7 pm with 30% reduction was sadly missed by us but fir top quality wines this is still a great venue 
The cheese plate was substantial and will be easily sufficient for two
Don’t miss Ajax Wednesday. Soft mellow jazz beautifully song and played by two local musicians. 
Overall this is a place to plan into any trip to Hanoi

A nice winebqr in the anciet city of Hanoi.
Feb 2024 • Family
Nice wine bar with a very good selection of wines, delicious cheese and very fresh, crispy baguettes. The music is tailored to European tastes and fits perfectly in this bar. Everything is very pleasant and atmospheric.

The bubbling sound with which mucus is drawn up from the nose into the throat is certainly not one of the more pleasant acoustic experiences. Unfortunately, the young bartender doesn't know this and is constantly busy with his slime, which is especially disgusting when you are eating.

Unfortunately, the staff is not very friendly to the guests. We were here practically every evening during our stay in Hanoi and the behavior hasn't changed. It's a shame, we would expect that at this price level and in a bar that is obviously aimed at European customers.

Disappointing
Aug 2020 • Couples
Wanted to visit this place for a long, managed to get there tonight. Great first arrivals, however let down with poor and clumsy service. Ordered 2 Pimms, took forever to arrive, all food was prepared from beneath the bar from a microwave. No clearing of old drinks and forgot our drinks order saying they were too busy....less than guests in the bar!!!
Food was good, however dont want see it being prepared when sat at the bar, with bare hands and straight from plastic bags.
Sorry guys you need to train your staff and prepare your food elsewhere as this detracts heavily from the overall ambiance.

Written August 28, 2020
Tannin Wine Bar
Sorry the service was not up to standard on your visit with the drink preparation. 

Also sorry the food preparation disrupted your enjoyment - we prepare cheese, charcuterie. paninis, pate, that kind of thing. Yes it is prepared at the bar. Any hot dishes are prepared in a very small kitchen area upstairs. No they don’t use bare hands, gloves are used. Yes food is kept in containers. No there is not a microwave - there is a panini press, to warm our baguettes (fitted under the bar counter). 

This is a small, friendly wine bar with very good pricing. I recommend you try a 5 star hotel to avoid these kind of upsets.
